test_cases.title: Previous Distributions finds a distribution by its reference
acs: DERIVED: Searching Previous Distributions by Distribution Reference lists that distribution - 15 references (data/seed/distributions.json)
assumptions: The external site runs at http://localhost:1688 with the local debug SSO user linked to the participant with Lab Code 1300 (data/seed/apply.sql).
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.
References come from the first page of the list.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 15 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.expected: The list and its search form are shown.

steps.action: Type the reference of the row in Distribution Reference.

steps.expected: A row with the reference and scheme code is listed.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.
